comment: Dr. Gentile is so smart and ethusiastic about teaching, she made this lab great! This was the first time that I didn't want to die in a chem lab, yay! Dr. Gentile is very helpful and effective at teaching concepts.

Dr. Gentile is a really great professor and totally everyone loved her! She was always willing to stay and help students when we had questions and was quick to email us back when she wasn't. I would say she was as clear as she could be given the difficulty of the content.

Gentile is terrible as a teacher.  She is pompous and won't tolerate students who do not blindly agree with everything she states.  She also assigns so much work that it is physically impossible to finish it all.  This was the most frustrating and time consuming class I have ever taken.  Avoid her at all costs.
